Dear Arnia,

Regarding the early check-in, please note that our standard check-in time starts from 3:00 PM.

Any early check-in is subject to availability and depends on the Upside Living team, as they are responsible for preparing the apartment. We will inform them of your early check-in request in advance; however, we are unable to confirm an early check-in from our side.

On the day of your arrival, you may also check with the reception team regarding the possibility of an earlier check-in.

Thank you for your understanding.
